packageRules.description: Base images pin version and digest in separate ARGs, which Renovate cannot update as one dependency. Upgraded by hand with NiFi.
NiFi Registry libraries need code adaptation. Upgraded by hand with NiFi.
These are modules of this repository, and the release plugin sets their versions, so Renovate has nothing to update.

The repositories in pom.xml include a URL that is not a Maven repository, a snapshots-only repository, and GitHub Packages, which needs credentials Renovate lacks. Third-party artifacts are looked up in Maven Central only, which cuts wasted requests and the rate limiting they cause.
Autotests generate certificates with nifi-toolkit 1.28.1. Newer versions do not work.
Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Spring Cloud majors break APIs, so they are upgraded by hand after dashboard approval.
Each Spring Boot minor needs a new Spring Cloud release train, which Renovate treats as a major, so Boot minors wait for approval too.
Quarkus majors break extensions and configuration. The Netcracker Quarkus BOM, the Netcracker Quarkus extensions, and SmallRye move together with the Quarkus platform.
Jackson 3 changes package names and group IDs, so Jackson majors are upgraded by hand.
SLF4J majors change how bindings are found, so the SLF4J API, Logback, and the JBoss LogManager binding move together.
Testcontainers 2 renames artifacts, JUnit 6 raises the Java baseline, and Mockito 5 changes the default mock maker, so test framework majors are upgraded by hand.
HikariCP, JGit, and PostgreSQL JDBC majors change APIs or the minimum Java version of the utilities that bundle them.
Code quality tool majors add or change rules and can fail the build, so their findings are fixed by hand during the upgrade.
Netty majors change the runtime APIs used by the Quarkus consul module.
Quarkus platform upgrades move together with core-quarkus-external-bom and are done by hand, so only 3.33.3.x builds are allowed.
core-quarkus-external-bom 1.0.9 requires Netty 4.1.x, so netty-bom stays on 4.1.x until that BOM moves to a newer Netty.

Majors of third-party images in the compose files, such as PostgreSQL, Keycloak, and Consul, can change data formats and configuration, so they are upgraded by hand. Renovate rejects ** combined with other patterns, so Netcracker images are not excluded here.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Repeat the rules above: a disabled dependency does not reliably stop a vulnerability alert PR, and none of these updates can be applied as Renovate proposes them.
